description: SQL support for Positron, including running statements against a data connection, completions, hovers and syntax diagnostics.
configuration.title: SQL
configuration.dialect.description: The SQL dialect used to parse `.sql` files. Affects syntax diagnostics and which quoting styles are accepted. Automatic follows the data connection a file is written against, and parses a file with no connection permissively, accepting a superset of most dialects and reporting fewer errors. Set a dialect here to use it for every `.sql` file whatever it is written against.
configuration.diagnostics.enabled.descri: Report syntax errors in SQL files.
configuration.connectOnOpen.description: Open the data connection a SQL file is written against when the file is opened, so its completions work without connecting by hand. Only applies to a file whose connection was chosen explicitly, and only once per connection: one that cannot be opened is not retried until the schema is refreshed. Turn this off if connecting is something you would rather do deliberately, such as when it prompts for credentials or costs money to wake a warehouse.
command.refreshDatabaseSchema.title: Refresh Database Schema
command.selectDataConnection.title: Select Data Connection
command.runStatement.title: Run SQL Statement
configuration.diagnostics.unknownNames.d: Report table and column names that are not in the data connection a file is written against. Reported as warnings, and skipped entirely while the file has no connection to check against or while a connection's schema is too large to read in full, so an incomplete picture cannot flag valid SQL.
